sentences.text: Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 10871 of 2023

Petitioner :- Ashish Shukla
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shrinath,Chandrakant Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.

Hon'ble Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava,J.
Heard Sri Shrinath, learned counsel for the petitioner and Sri Pankaj Saxena, learned AGA-I appearing for the State-respondent.

The present petition has been filed seeking a direction to the Judicial Magistrate-I, Chitrakoot to decide the Case No.800 of 2021 (State Vs. Ashish Shukla) arising out of Case Crime No.445 of 2020,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 DP Act, Police Station Kotwali Karvi,
District Chitrakoot, within a stipulated time period.

entities.text: Case No.800 of 2021 (State Vs. Ashish Shukla)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner has not been able to point out any special circumstance which may warrant issuance of a direction to the court concerned to hear the case out of turn.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Having regard to the aforesaid, this Court is not inclined to entertain this petition in exercise of its supervisory power under Article 227 of the Constitution of India for issuing a direction to decide the case, within a stipulated time period.
It would, however, be open to the petitioner to approach the court concerned, where the case is stated to be pending, seeking appropriate relief in this regard.
The petition stands disposed of accordingly.
